clips.title: The story
paras: At Hallow's End, Innkeeper Firebrew asks visitors in Ironforge to cluck for a mint meant for Jesper, a young orphan in Stormwind. Alliance champions gather holiday sweets from their capitals to bring him cheer.

Young Jesper in Stormwind longs for Hallow's End sweets, though sickness and orphanhood keep him from joining the festivities. Alliance champions gather treats for him from innkeepers in the Alliance capitals, giving seasoned adventurers a reason to go door to door during the harvest-to-winter celebration.

At the Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge's Commons, Innkeeper Firebrew keeps the Ironforge Mints. Asking politely is not enough; visitors must flap their arms and cluck like chickens before he parts with one. The performance gives the tavern's patrons a laugh, and the mint helps bring holiday cheer to Jesper.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, trick-or-treating for a sick child, are we? I was going to say, you're a little old to be rummaging about for candies...

Well, for my treat - an Ironforge Mint - you will need to... Cluck like a chicken! Yes, chickens love mints... Well OK, maybe they don't LOVE them... But I won't give you a mint unless you chicken cluck for me!
Well adventurer, are you up to the challenge or not?! Time to earn your treat!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Too funny! Well done, friend! Here's your treat.
